content.title: About the Office of the Solicitor General | Attorney General Brian Schwalb
content.text: Skip to main content The Child Support Services Division (CSSD) will be closed on Thursday, April 16, 2026 for DC Emancipation Day. The office will reopen on Friday, April 17, 2026 at 8:15am. About the Office of the Solicitor General facebook email print X Office of the Solicitor General The Office of the Solicitor General handles litigation for the Office of the Attorney General in the appellate courts, including the District of Columbia Court of Appeals, the United States Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit and the Supreme Court of the United States. The Office’s cases include appeals from trial courts in a wide variety of civil and criminal matters and petitions for review from more than fifty District agencies.
